review_request.review_focus: Validation behavior at the zero boundary.
review_request.title: Keep timeout validation strict
review_request.user_intent: Reject both zero and negative timeout values while simplifying the validation.

expected_claims.text: A timeout of zero must be rejected.
A negative timeout must be rejected.

expected_findings.claim: The new comparison accepts a zero timeout even though zero must remain invalid.
expected_findings.rationale: Base rejects zero and negative values with <= 0, while head changes the boundary to < 0 and therefore accepts zero. A zero timeout now reaches callers despite the explicit acceptance criterion. This is a required medium regression because one supported validation boundary is lost while negative handling remains intact; the complete cause, trigger, and impact are visible in the diff.
